thread:
Elena (Aperture): Hey team — Aperture ready to onboard our hybrid reranker+generator for retail search. Need a private deployment or dedicated pool, PHI-safe storage for invoices, and an eval plan before our renewal review. Can we scope this for a staged canary in the next 3 weeks?
Sam (CS): Thanks Elena — noted. Can you confirm peak qps, p95 latency target, and whether embeddings must stay in your VPC?
Elena (Aperture): Peak 20 qps, p95 goal <= 300ms, yes embeddings must be in our VPC (we have strict PHI contract). Also want a fallback model if latency spikes.
Toni (SE): Ok. Dedicated capacity + VPC private deployment is doable. We'll need an onboarding checklist: KMS keys, TLS certs, model artifact access control, and eval prompt set.
Lee (ML): For the reranker+gen combo we should run these evals: retrieval quality (MRR@10), rerank NDCG@5, and generation safety tests (PHI leakage on prompt variations). I can assemble scripts.
Mira (Security): From compliance: we need a Data Processing Addendum, KMS integration verification, and HSM/KMS logs forwarded to your SIEM. Also confirm that we keep embeddings encrypted-at-rest and never send raw PHI to hosted models.
Elena (Aperture): We'll sign the DPA. We use AWS KMS and Splunk for logs. Happy to share the key ARN.
Sam (CS): Great. I'm going to schedule a technical kickoff with Toni/Lee/Mira. Tentative runway: canary (5% traffic) -> 25% -> full over 2 weeks if metrics stable. Renewal review: if we can't meet p95 SLA, finance has signaled risk of not renewing. So smoothing this is high priority.
Toni (SE): For canary we recommend a model variant with FP16 quant + KV cache enabled. Also set a cost/loss budget so we can auto-fallback if p50 latency > 220ms for 5m. Example policy snippet:
```json
{"route":"aperture-retail","policy":{"canary_pct":5,"fallback_model":"gptx-7b-q8","latency_slo_ms":300,"auto_fallback_window_s":300}}
```
Sam (CS): @Lee can you prepare the eval deck and a small dataset (1k queries + gold labels) so product can sign off? Toni,  any infra prerequisites for the private deploy?
Lee (ML): Will do. I’ll push a sample eval harness to the repo and point to artifact locations. Asking @Elena for a representative query set and some red-team prompts for PHI.
Toni (SE): Infra notes: VPC peering, NAT ingress rules for model pull, and a service account with least privilege. We'll need a 3-node GPU pool to hit 20 qps with target latency. I'll estimate cost and include burst rules.
Mira (Security): Also adding a manual checklist: penetration test window, KMS key rotation policy, and audit log retention 13 months.
Elena (Aperture): Sounds good. Question — do you support token-level cost breakdowns so our finance team can forecast spend next quarter?
Sam (CS): Yes — Redwood Console gives token-level cost, per-route dashboards. I’ll attach a short cost forecast template after the kickoff.
Toni (SE): Next steps: Toni + Lee to own eval run, Mira to sign off security checklist, Sam to coordinate kickoff + renewal notes. Elena to provide sample dataset and key ARN.
Elena (Aperture): I'll send dataset and key ARN by EOD Monday. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Sam (CS): Cool — scheduling kickoff now. Ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduling meeting: "Aperture onboarding kickoff" on 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC (invites sent).
Toni (SE): I'll pre-populate an onboarding tracker and include target KPIs: p95 latency <=300ms, MRR@10 >= baseline+12%, hallucination rate < 0.2%.
Lee (ML): Adding eval scripts: <https://git.redwood.ai/aperture/onboard-evals> — will add test vectors tomorrow.
Mira (Security): Noted risk: if canary shows PHI red flags (any leakage), we stop rollout and initiate incident path.
Sam (CS): Understood. I'll flag renewal owners and add this to the account health doc. We want green by renewal or risk of delayed renewal discussion.
Elena (Aperture): Thanks all — will stand by for kickoff notes and the tracker.
Sam (CS): Closing loop: kickoff scheduled, tracker link to follow, tagging @finance for spend forecast.
